designationHistory.indexText: The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service established Black Bayou Lake National Wildlife Refuge by signing a lease for the lake and surrounding land.

authority.citation: Lease agreement signed by the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Black Bayou Lake National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

USFWS, 508 Black Bayou Lake National Wildlife Refuge Comprehensive Conservation Plan (ServCat 168182): "The refuge was formally established on June 16, 1997, when assistant regional director Geoff Haskett signed the lease"

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Black Bayou Lake National Wildlife Refuge was established in 1997.
